newsitem.title: UZBEKISTAN: Guards kill one trespasser on Tajik-Afghan border.
newsitem.headline: Guards kill one trespasser on Tajik-Afghan border.

text.p: Russian border guards on Monday shot dead one person and detained another three who tried to cross the Tajik-Afghan border, a border guard spokesman said.

"Early on Monday morning the trespassers crossed the border river Pyandzh from Afghanistan, in an attempt to sneak illegally into Tajikistan," the spokesman told Reuters by telephone from the Tajik capital Dushanbe.
Earlier this month Russian border guards, who control the Tajik-Afghan border under a bilateral agreement with Dushanbe, killed six unidentified people who tried to cross the frontier.
Officials found 74 kg (160 lbs) of opium among the belongings of the dead.
The press officer did not give any details about the people killed and seized in the latest incident.

Russia keeps a large contingent in Tajikistan, a remote mountainous republic of 5.7 million people, and views its peacekeepers and border guards as a bulwark against militant Islam reaching its southern borders across the territory of Tajikistan and other Central Asian states.

A ceasefire agreed last December between Tajikistan's secular government and the country's Islamist opposition seems to be holding but Russian border guards and Tajik officials say that separate groups of Islamist fighters are still operating from bases in neighbouring Afghanistan.
They have also said the situation was aggravated by trafficking of cheap drugs -- mostly opium -- from Afghanistan to countries of the former Soviet Union and Europe across Tajik territory.
